name: Stone Goliath

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: When you take damage, you can use your Reaction to reduce that damage by 1d12 plus your Constitution modifier. You can do so a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

traits.name: Stone Strike
traits.description: Once per turn, when you hit with a melee or thrown-weapon attack, you can spend one use of Stone's Endurance to deal 1d6 additional Force damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a Strength saving throw or is pushed 10 feet directly away from you. This is a different activation of the existing ancestry use pool.

traits.name: Cavernous Sight
traits.description: You gain Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.

traits.name: Stone Throw
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, you magically hurl a rock at a target within 60 feet using a ranged spell attack based on your chosen Goliath ancestry ability. On a hit, the rock deals 1d10 Force damage, and the target makes a Strength saving throw or becomes Prone. You can use this ability Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

reviewNotes: SRD 5.2.1 Giant Ancestry adapted into one selectable Subspecies, not six independent options granted to every Goliath.
Inherits Powerful Build, Large Form, size and Speed from species.goliath; the chosen ancestry boon uses Proficiency Bonus activations per Long Rest.
Effects are a coherent first-pass baseline and remain open to future reconciliation and playtesting.

Selected for first-pass playtesting: each ancestry's Strike-derived early mode is merged with the SRD boon instead of granting an independent Strike of the Giants feat; Fire's Burn already contains Fire Strike.

Early Strike modes share the original ancestry's Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest and never grant an extra use pool. Modes with Bigby's weapon-hit restriction retain that restriction; core SRD boons are not narrowed.

Advanced inherited features unlock at total character level 4. Their source-feat prerequisites and +1 Ability Score Increase are not additional grants; save/attack modifiers use the Goliath's selected giant ancestry aptitude.
Other feats, rune training and giant cultural backgrounds remain independent options and are not automatically provided by Species inheritance.

stone Goliath's advanced features were adapted from the corresponding *Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants* giant feat; cultural and rune feats remain separate. No feat or ability-score-increase entitlement is awarded.
